entities.name: HIV-1 Env gp160
observations: 768-aa sequence; estimated unmodified molecular mass 87.38 kDa and theoretical pI 8.46.
Matches reviewed HIV-1 gp160 references at 74.7–79.1% identity with ~100% query coverage; this supports gp160 identification but does not establish isolate/subtype.
Pfam detects GP120 (PF00516) at residues 33–504 and GP41 (PF00517) at residues 523–714.
Reference gp160 is a glycosylated, furin/furin-like protease-cleaved precursor yielding gp120 and gp41; mature Env forms a trimer of heterodimers.
gp120 mediates host attachment via CD4 and coreceptor engagement (CCR5 and/or CXCR4); gp41 mediates class-I viral membrane fusion.
Reference localization includes viral envelope/virion membrane and host-cell/endosomal membranes; reference GO annotations include viral attachment, viral protein processing, and membrane fusion.
